description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeSkillDao class within the OrangeHRM project, focusing on CRUD operations and skill retrieval functionality for employee skills.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeSkillDao methods including retrieval, creation, deletion, and filtering of employee skills.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of EmployeeSkillDao and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an employee skill by ID and verifies comments and years of experience.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests bulk deletion of employee skills and verifies the number of deleted records.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests searching employee skills by employee number and verifies the count and instance type.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSkillWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching employee skills with a limit and verifies the number of results.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests saving a new EmployeeSkill entity with specific comments and experience years.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests editing an existing EmployeeSkill entity and verifies the updated fields.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests counting employee skills based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedSkills
methods.description: Tests retrieval of allowed skills for employees, comparing against the repository data, and verifying skill names for specific employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of allowed skills for specific employees.
